$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (eudi-wallet-credential-issuance). First fragment in this codebase to exercise the components.schemas half of the mechanism (every prior fragment only seeded components.objects) — see openspec/changes/eudi-wallet-credential-issuance/design.md D-SCHEMA. DEFERRED_QUESTION resolved: lib/Repair/InitializeRegister.php's deepMergeConfig() generically merges the WHOLE descriptor (not just objects/) — list arrays concatenate, associative arrays recurse by key — confirmed by tracing InitializeRegister.php:135-225 and OpenRegister's ImportHandler::importFromApp()/importFromJson() (lib/Service/Configuration/ImportHandler.php:1602-1803), which reads components.schemas generically and additionally requires each new schema slug to be listed under components.registers.<slug>.schemas[] (a plain list, so it concatenates cleanly with the base 20-entry list) or the schema is imported but never attached to the openconnector register. Declares the three schemas backing the OpenID4VCI (pre-authorized code flow) EUDI wallet credential issuer adapter: eudi_credential_offer (one row per created offer), eudi_issuance_session (token/credential-endpoint session state), and eudi_status_list (one row per published OAuth Status List Token, draft-ietf-oauth-status-list). Deliberately does NOT edit lib/Settings/openconnector_register.json — that file's own declared schema count (verified by tests/Unit/Settings/RegisterDescriptorTest.php, which parses ONLY that file) is unaffected by this fragment.

eudi_credential_offer.title: EUDI Credential Offer
eudi_credential_offer.summary: An OpenID4VCI pre-authorized-code credential offer created by a consuming app
eudi_credential_offer.description: One row per credential offer created via POST /api/eudi/credential-offers. Carries the already-assembled/already-signed credential payload the consuming app handed over, the hashed pre-authorized_code (never plaintext), the assigned status-list bit, and the offer's single-fetch/short-TTL lifecycle state. See openspec/changes/eudi-wallet-credential-issuance/specs/eudi-wallet-credential-issuance/spec.md#req-eudi-004.

consumerId.description: FK to the consumer that created this offer (REQ-EUDI-004); only this consumer may resolve/revoke it
consumerId.title: Consumer

format.description: OpenID4VCI credential format: jwt_vc_json is returned verbatim at issuance (already signed by the consuming app), dc+sd-jwt is minted and signed by this adapter's own issuer key
format.title: Credential Format

credentialConfigurationId.description: Which credential_configurations_supported entry this offer maps to (e.g. edci-diploma, open-badges-3)
credentialConfigurationId.title: Credential Configuration ID

credentialPayload.description: The already-assembled credential content the consuming app handed over: for jwt_vc_json a compact VC-JWT string returned byte-identical at issuance (never re-signed); for dc+sd-jwt a JSON-encoded claims object this adapter mints and signs into an SD-JWT VC at issuance time
credentialPayload.title: Credential Payload

subjectId.description: Identifier of the credential subject (learner/holder) supplied by the consuming app
subjectId.title: Subject ID

organisationId.description: OpenRegister organisation this offer and its signing key are scoped to (falls back to a single default-organisation scope when unavailable)
organisationId.title: Organisation ID

preAuthorizedCodeHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the single-use pre-authorized_code; the plaintext code is never persisted (mirrors the whsec_-secret hygiene pattern)
preAuthorizedCodeHash.title: Pre-Authorized Code Hash

txCodeRequired.description: Whether a tx_code (PIN), delivered out-of-band by the consuming app, must be presented at the token endpoint
txCodeRequired.title: TX Code Required

txCodeHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the required tx_code PIN; never persisted in plaintext
txCodeHash.title: TX Code Hash

txCodeFailedAttempts.description: Count of wrong tx_code presentations, used to rate-limit brute-force PIN guessing without consuming the pre-authorized_code
txCodeFailedAttempts.title: TX Code Failed Attempts

status.description: Offer lifecycle status: created (not yet exchanged), claimed (pre-authorized_code exchanged for an access token), expired, revoked
status.title: Status

statusListId.description: FK to the eudi_status_list row this credential's revocation bit lives on
statusListId.title: Status List

statusListIndex.description: This credential's assigned bit index within its status list's bitstring
statusListIndex.title: Status List Index

callbackUrl.description: Optional consumer-configured URL that receives an HMAC-signed status callback on revocation (REQ-EUDI-009)
callbackUrl.title: Callback URL

callbackSigningSecret.description: whsec_-prefixed HMAC secret (WebhookSignatureService, REQ-WHS-001 scheme) used to sign the revocation status callback. writeOnly (ocon#147 phase C): OpenRegister's render boundary strips it from EVERY API response — the description previously CLAIMED it was 'never returned', but the generic /apps/openregister/api/objects API and MCP tools read the row directly and did return it; writeOnly makes the claim true. EudiCredentialOfferService reads it via _rbac: false (system context), which the writeOnly stripping never touches, so callback signing is unaffected.
callbackSigningSecret.title: Callback Signing Secret

offerFetchedAt.description: Set atomically on the offer's first successful credential_offer_uri fetch (REQ-EUDI-005 single-use marker); a second fetch is rejected once set
offerFetchedAt.title: Offer Fetched At

revokedAt.description: Timestamp the offer's credential was revoked, if applicable
revokedAt.title: Revoked At

expiresAt.description: Offer resolution deadline (default 15 minutes after creation); an unresolved offer past this timestamp is unresolvable even if never fetched
expiresAt.title: Expires At

eudi_issuance_session.title: EUDI Issuance Session
eudi_issuance_session.summary: Token/credential-endpoint session state for one claimed credential offer
eudi_issuance_session.description: Created when a pre-authorized_code is successfully exchanged at POST /api/eudi/token. Holds the hashed opaque access_token, the current c_nonce for proof-of-possession, and the single-use consumption marker enforced at POST /api/eudi/credential. See openspec/changes/eudi-wallet-credential-issuance/specs/eudi-wallet-credential-issuance/spec.md#req-eudi-006.

offerId.description: FK to the eudi_credential_offer this session was issued for
offerId.title: Credential Offer

accessTokenHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the opaque access_token returned to the wallet; the plaintext token is never persisted
accessTokenHash.title: Access Token Hash

cNonce.description: The current proof-of-possession nonce a wallet's proof.jwt must echo
cNonce.title: C Nonce

format.description: Copied from the parent offer for fast dispatch at the credential endpoint
format.title: Credential Format

consumedAt.description: Set atomically once a credential has been successfully issued from this session (REQ-EUDI-007 single-use consumption); a second POST /api/eudi/credential presentation is rejected as a replay once set
consumedAt.title: Consumed At

expiresAt.description: Session expiry; a Bearer token presented after this timestamp is rejected
expiresAt.title: Expires At

eudi_status_list.title: EUDI Status List
eudi_status_list.summary: A published OAuth Status List Token bitstring (single-bit revocation only)
eudi_status_list.description: One row per published draft-ietf-oauth-status-list token, GET /api/eudi/status-lists/{id}. bits is fixed at 1 (revocation only, no 2-bit suspension in this change per design.md D-REVOKE). The current signed token is cached on the row and periodically re-signed by EudiStatusListRefreshJob before its own exp elapses. See openspec/changes/eudi-wallet-credential-issuance/specs/eudi-wallet-credential-issuance/spec.md#req-eudi-008.

organisationId.description: OpenRegister organisation this status list is scoped to (falls back to a single default-organisation scope when unavailable); one status list per organisation is created lazily on first offer
organisationId.title: Organisation ID

purpose.description: Status purpose per draft-ietf-oauth-status-list; only revocation is supported in this change
purpose.title: Purpose

bits.description: Bits per status entry; fixed at 1 (single-bit revocation only, no suspension) per design.md D-REVOKE
bits.title: Bits Per Entry

capacity.description: Total number of assignable bit indices in this list
capacity.title: Capacity

nextFreeIndex.description: Next unassigned bit index; incremented each time a credential offer is assigned a status-list slot
nextFreeIndex.title: Next Free Index

bitstring.description: Canonical internal bit representation (0=valid, 1=revoked) indexed by statusListIndex; encoded to the draft's compressed lst byte-string only when the token is (re-)signed
bitstring.title: Bitstring

issuerKid.description: kid fingerprint of the issuer key that signed the currently-cached token
issuerKid.title: Issuer Key ID

currentToken.description: The currently-published, signed OAuth Status List Token (JWT). NOTE: this token is public by design — wallets fetch it verbatim from the GET /api/eudi/status-lists/{id} endpoint to check revocation — so writeOnly here is API-surface reduction / defence-in-depth (ocon#147 names it), not a confidentiality fix; the row's actual signing key lives encrypted in IAppConfig via EudiIssuerKeyService, never in this schema. writeOnly is safe because the publish path (EudiStatusListService::getPublishedToken) and every other reader use _rbac: false, which the stripping never touches, so the public status-list endpoint is unaffected.
currentToken.title: Current Token

currentTokenExp.description: exp claim of the currently-cached token; EudiStatusListRefreshJob re-signs before this elapses
currentTokenExp.title: Current Token Expiry
